questions.question_text: What protocol does Socket.IO primarily establish over HTTP for persistent bidirectional communication?
questions.explanation: Socket.IO upgrades HTTP connections to real-time WebSockets.

questions.question_text: In React, which hook is most appropriate for establishing a WebSocket connection on component mount?
questions.explanation: useEffect with an empty dependency array executes once on mount for lifecycle connections.

questions.question_text: What is the primary role of an authoritative backend in a competitive multiplayer quiz?
questions.option_a: Render React components on the server

questions.question_text: What data structure offers O(1) average time complexity for key lookups in Node.js?
questions.explanation: Hash maps provide constant-time O(1) key retrieval.
